title: Go: Goroutine Leak Prevention
description: Write a Go program that demonstrates proper goroutine cleanup using context cancellation.
hints: Use `context.WithCancel` to create a cancellable context
Goroutines should check `ctx.Done()` via select to know when to stop
Call `cancel()` when the goroutine's work is no longer needed
Always clean up goroutines to prevent memory leaks
